title: Tesla Registered 285 Cybercabs In One Day

sentences.text: Tesla just registered 285 Cybercabs in one day.
A new record. The old mark was about 200.
Texas now lists 1,107. First time past 1,000.
Tesla has 1,841 robotaxis there. Waymo has 1,409.
About 60 percent of that fleet has no steering wheel.
These cars carry riders in Austin and Dallas.
Registered does not mean every one is giving rides yet.
